newsitem.title: USA: CGT restores all 150 mmcfd gas production.
newsitem.headline: CGT restores all 150 mmcfd gas production.

text.p: Columbia Gulf Transmission (CGT) said Thursday it restored all 150 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas production shut earlier today on the system due to a cold snap along the U.S. Gulf Coast.
"A total of 150 mmcfd was lost due to weather-related problems. All of it is back on," a company spokesman said.
He noted the restrictions were at gas fields both offshore and onshore Louisiana.
Columbia Gas Transmission is a unit of The Columbia Gas System Inc.
